title: Beer and Wine
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 56.64 Linked Discourses 56.64
  • 7. Paṭhamaāmakadhaññapeyyālavagga 7. Abbreviated Texts on Raw Grain

Surāmerayasutta Beer and Wine

… “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā; atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā apaṭiviratā …pe…. “… the sentient beings who refrain from intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor, are few, while those who don’t refrain are many. …”

Catutthaṁ.
